# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **January 2026 generated 62% of trailing-year GMV** — A single month produced $2.28M of the $3.66M trailing-12-month total, with $5,853 AOV versus $1,653 in non-peak months, confirming heavy market-event dependence. [→ §commerce]
2. **HFC and quote workflows carry 59% of GMV on 26% of volume** — 315 orders through Hold For Confirmation ($5,929 avg) and Quote ($15,794 avg) workflows generated $2.17M, making approval-gated processes the primary GMV driver. [→ §commerce]
3. **Top-5 buyer concentration is healthy at 22.7%** — Below the 25% risk threshold, but the top 3 accounts are all dormant institutional buyers whose combined $650K in GMV is at risk of non-renewal. [→ §commerce]
4. **Steady-state ordering runs ~70 orders/month at ~$1,200 AOV** — Outside the January and June spikes, the base-case eCat run rate is approximately $84K/month in GMV, establishing a floor for non-event-driven revenue. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **URGENCY**: Protect HFC approval turnaround time — at 284 orders and $1.68M in annual GMV, even modest delays in the Hold For Confirmation workflow could disproportionately impact nearly half of total eCat revenue [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §commerce]
